newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AMS off ahead of 9-mth earnings.
newsitem.headline: AMS off ahead of 9-mth earnings.

text.p: Shares in Austria Mikro Systeme International AG dipped 3.63 percent in Vienna on Wednesday, as investors bailed out ahead of nine-month results they fear could disappoint.

At 1112 GMT AMS stood 27.2 schillings down at 721.3 in brisk trade, making it the biggest decliner in the ATX index, and brokers said further losses could be on the cards ahead of the earnings data due on Thursday.
"There are a few sizeable sellers in the market," said a broker, forecasting a decline towards 715-720 schillings by the close.
"But then the expected poor earnings will be in the price and I do not expect to see AMS come off too much further on Thursday," he continued.

AMS posted a group pre-tax loss of 3.1 million schillings in the first half of the year. After an initial slump to 640 schillings in August, speculative buying pushed the share price back up to 900 early this month.
"What we are seeing now is a counter-movement," a trader said.
